title: NeuroStrata project root marker
description: The file .NeuroStrata/config.json. The folder that holds it is a NeuroStrata project root. NeuroStrata checks the same rules in code (src/root_marker.rs); this schema documents them and is not loaded at runtime.

version.description: File format version. A file with any other version is treated as unreadable.

namespace.description: The NeuroStrata namespace this project uses. 1-64 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -, must not start with '.', and never contains ':'.
